name: FIN7
description: FIN7 (Carbon Spider) is a Russian cybercriminal APT group active since 2013, causing an estimated $3 billion in losses through phishing, malware, and supply chain attacks. The group operated through a fake cybersecurity company called Combi Security and had over 70 employees in distinct business units. Declared 'dead' by US authorities after 2023 convictions but revived in 2024, building 4,000+ phishing domains spoofing brands like Microsoft, Google, Netflix, and Cisco using hosting from Stark Industries Solutions.

sources.title: How Cyber Crime Group FIN7 Attacked Hundreds of U.S. Companies — FBI
The Stark Truth Behind the Resurgence of Russia's Fin7 — Krebs on Security
